title: BEST: reference booking-escrow contracts, tests, and simulations
description: Reference smart-contract escrow, verification scripts, gas benchmark with hard-fork checks, public Sepolia campaign records, cost model, and discrete-event simulation accompanying the article 'BEST: Design and Evaluation of a Blockchain Escrow for Tourism Bookings and Community Fund Allocation' (Journal of Logistics, Informatics and Service Science, under review). Version 1.1.0 corresponds to the first revision.
